caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object with a cylindrical base and a prominent, curved hook extending upward from its top. The hook has a pointed end with a notch, and it is connected to a box-like structure that is part of the main cylinder. On the right side of the cylinder, there is a ring attached, lying horizontally. The object is rendered in shades of brown and gray, suggesting a metallic, possibly iron or steel material, and is shown against a plain, light beige background. The drawing is detailed with highlights and shadows to give a three-dimensional appearance. In the lower right corner, there is small text reading, "DEL. 1901 MILFORD LEE."
title: Barrel Lock
